resources.string: Helps you open apps, navigate screens, and perform voice-requested touch actions during an active Sumu AI session. Never collects passwords or private credentials.

Sumu AI Privacy & Safety:
1. The microphone is active only when you start a call with Sumu.
2. Screen sharing starts only after Android's official consent prompt.
3. API keys are encrypted in Android Keystore and never logged.
4. Passwords, PINs, and payment prompts are never accessed.
